title: Transfer news LIVE: Man Utd deal takes twist, Julian Alvarez update, Tottenham eye £80m star - The Mirror
text:
Hello, and welcome to the Mirror's transfer news blog on Monday July 13.

World Cup fever may still be gripping the planet, but the summer transfer window is beginning to get even more exciting.

There have already been plenty of huge deals, particularly from Tottenham, who have already surpassed the £200million mark by signing Mateus Fernandes, Sandro Tonali and Jan Paul van Hecke.

Meanwhile, Manchester United have already had many setbacks, but there has been an update on one key deal.

Moreover, after Julian Alvarez scored one of the finest goals of the World Cup against Switzerland, the Argentine star is now back in the transfer headlines.

Mirror Football will be across all of this and plenty more. Stay tuned and stay here for all of the latest transfer updates, news and gossip.

Mason Greenwood looks set to move to Turkish heavyweights Fenerbahce. Greenwood had been heavily linked with a move to Saudi Arabian side Al-Ahli.

However, it's now understood by Give Me Sport that Fenerbahce believe they have stolen a march on the Saudi Pro League side. They have an agreement in principle with Marseille and are confident about signing him.

Mason Greenwood is set to leave Marseille(Image: Getty Images)

Coventry City are plotting a move for Norway ace Patrick Berg. The midfielder impressed for the Scandinavians in the World Cup, playing the full 120 minutes against England in the quarter-final.

It's now been claimed by TEAMtalk that Frank Lampard's side, as well as Ipswich Town, Hull City, West Ham and Burnley, are considering making a move for him.

(Image: Harry Langer/DeFodi Images/Shutterstock)

Ruben Amorim is considering a move for Manchester United ace Noussair Mazraoui. Amorim is now the manager of Manchester United, seven months after he was sacked by the Reds.

Since he took over at the Serie A heavyweights, he has been linked with Manuel Ugarte, Mason Mount and Amad Diallo. Now, according to the Metro, Amorim is keen on reuniting with the Moroccan international.

Mazraoui featured regularly for Amorim, who often used the versatile defender as one of the three central defenders in his back line.

Noussair Mazraoui celebrates the victory(Image: ANP/Shutterstock)

Arsenal are set to jumpstart their interest in Atletico Madrid and Argentina forward Julian Alvarez, according to the Independent. Alvarez has been linked with the Gunners for the majority of the summer.

He did have his heart set on a move to Barcelona, but Atletico have been left unimpressed by the way they have negotiated and have referred the Catalans to his humongous €500m buyout clause.

However, Arsenal would not have to meet that figure. Instead, it's believed £100m may be enough for Atletico to sell to the Gunners.

Barcelona, Real Madrid and Arsenal have all been linked with Julian Alvarez(Image: Getty Images)

Tottenham could take their transfer spending past the £300m mark with a huge move for Bournemouth ace Eli Junior Kroupi.

The Cherries' forward, who is believed to be valued at around £80m, is understood to now be of interest to the north Londoners, according to Give Me Sport. Spurs have already shattered the £200m mark having signed Mateus Fernandes, Sandro Tonali, Jan paul van Hecke and others.

Manchester United have insisted they could still wrap up a deal for Ederson. The Brazilian midfielder had seemingly been signed by the club, until a troubling medical detected a knee issue.

Despite reports claiming a deal is now not happening, the Manchester Evening News have claimed the club have not given up on signing him yet. More medical tests are to be carried out and if they are positive, then United are confident they will sign Ederson from Atalanta for £38m.

(Image: Getty Images)

Good morning everybody - it's a new week, which means another week of transfer news.

Do you think Manchester United will eventually get hold of Ederson? Will Julian Alvarez find himself at Arsenal until after the World Cup? Do Tottenham Hotspur really have more money to spend?

All of this and many more will be dicussed in today's transfer blog!
